title: FIX-AUDIT [W4]: outcome_from_string wrapper still orphaned in production; fix-commit doc claims a rationale no caller embodies
detail: The drift-hazard core is fixed (one mapping, exhaustive round-trip pin). But repo-wide grep shows outcome_from_string callers only in shared/test/reference_call_test.gleam:270,298,302 — zero production call sites — while its new doc claims it "exists for code that must always produce a value". No such code exists.
recommended_fix: Delete the wrapper and its test assertions, or reword the doc to state it is currently test-only; reintroduce it only alongside a real caller.

title: FIX-AUDIT [N7]: substitute message-payload construction remains shape-exempt from the hooks lint — gate still code-review/tests only
evidence:
event.on_click(msg.UserChoseRefcheckAction(
              call.reference_call_id,
              RefcheckSubstitute,
            )),

# `(` call arg / `{` import / top-level: exempt by shape
detail: The construction at reference_panel.gleam:1055 sits inside view_substitute_surface_open, reachable only through the hook gate at line 1029, but the lint (scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:143) exempts call-arg shapes. The fix commit documented the exemption (lint doc lines 25-26, "panel tests pin those surfaces (N7)") but did not extend the lint, so the r1 exposure remains: a future re-derivation via message payload escapes CI linting.
recommended_fix: Extend the lint to require UserChoseRefcheckAction take-over/substitute payload constructions to sit inside hook-gated render paths, or move the construction below the gate as r1 recommended.

title: Lockstep direction 2 iterates a hardcoded 14-string list — a future enum addition to is_terminal_status is invisible to the pin, contradicting the test's 'both directions' claim
evidence:
/// status the shared fn calls terminal, and every status string the shared
/// fn calls terminal is IN the const. Editing the const (or the shared fn)
/// without the other fails here — the exact mirror-drift the AR-RC13 guard
/// exists to prevent.
pub fn terminal_statuses_lockstep_with_shared_truth_test() {
  ...
  let all_status_strings = [
    "queued",
    "skipped",
    "contact_initiated",
    "awaiting_correction",
    "scheduled",
    "calling",
    "completed",
    "partial",
    "form_completed",
    "unreachable",
    "refused",
    "objected",
    "manual_recorded",
    "failed",
  ]
detail: Direction 2 checks only the 14 hardcoded strings, so ADDING a status (v2 voice is the stated plan) to the shared enum and is_terminal_status without updating the exported terminal_statuses const leaves this test green — then build_lifecycle_entries' `list.contains(terminal_statuses, status)` (handler:1465) silently omits the terminal event. The test and AR-RC13 register both claim additions fail; they do not.
recommended_fix: Export an all-status-strings list from the shared package (single home) and iterate it in direction 2, so enum additions are visible to the lockstep pin.
